question: **The calorific value of a medium size banana is 110 and it is richest in: **
solution:
The correct answer is: **carbohydrate**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The second sentence of the sixth paragraph of the given passage states that, *"One medium banana (126 gms) provides about 110 calories, 0 gram fat, 1 gram protein, 28 grams carbohydrate__, 15 grams sugar (naturally occurring), 3 grams fibre and 450 mg potassium and trace quantities of vitamin C and B6, according to the Hyderabad-based National Institute of Nutrition."*
 
• So, it is clearly mentioned that,
 
 
• The amount of **Potassium is 450 milligrams**.
 
• The amount of** Fibre is 3 grams**.
 
• The amount of **Protein is 1 gram.**
 
• The amount of **carbohydrates is 28 grams.**
 
 
 
• From here it is clear that, A medium size banana is richest in carbohydrate. 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
